title: TelemetryEvent
description: Schema for telemetry events produced by M1 (Identity & Context Engine) and consumed by M5 (ML Risk-Scoring) and M4 (Vulnerability & Posture). Version 1.0 – frozen for Phase 1.

schema_version.description: Contract schema version. Must equal '1.0' for this revision.

session_id.description: Unique identifier for the user session (UUID recommended).

user_id.description: Authenticated user identifier (username or sub claim).

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the event (e.g. 2024-01-01T00:00:00+00:00).

event_type.description: Semantic classification of the telemetry event.

source_ip.description: Source IP address of the request (IPv4 or IPv6 string).

geo.description: Geolocation context derived from source_ip via MaxMind GeoLite2 or equivalent.

raw_features.description: Arbitrary numeric/string feature bag for ML consumption. Keys are feature names; values must be numbers or strings.
